siteEvidence.modernSiteLabel: Ancient site at Mathura, Uttar Pradesh

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Before Krishna: Religious Diversity in Ancient Mathura
historicalIdentityEvidence.locator: Foreword, ancient mounds and Kankali Tila discussion
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Mathura has a complex, multi-layered archaeological landscape rather than one recoverable ancient-city point.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not identify the Chapter XIV root term Māthuraka as an exact city coordinate.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: CGVO G1 Mathuraka overlay
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: The G1 source overlay retains Māthuraka as a people-or-urban association connected to Mathura.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: The root source does not reduce the term to a city point.

coordinateEvidence.title: Sites along the Uttarapath, Badshahi Sadak, Sadak-e-Azam, Grand Trunk Road
coordinateEvidence.supports: A named ancient-site reference with a published latitude/longitude pair.
coordinateEvidence.limitations: The held listing does not identify a coordinate reference system or specify whether the point is an excavation locus, property reference, or another site reference.

temporalApplicability.periodLabel: ancient and early medieval Mathura archaeological landscape

siteEvidence.uncertainty: Māthuraka remains an association term; the published heritage coordinate has an unresolved CRS and reference-point meaning.
limitations: Root term is not reduced to a city point.
No Mathura urban extent or region boundary.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Archaeological Survey of India Patna Circle: Monuments Details
historicalIdentityEvidence.locator: items 40-42, old and new Rajgriha walls and enclosed remains
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Old and new Rajgriha are protected archaeological contexts; the cycleopean walls are dated to the 6th-5th century BCE.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: The protected complex includes many structures and does not select one coordinate reference point.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Rajagirha: An early historic site in East India
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Identifies ancient Rajagriha with modern Rajgir as an early historic archaeological site.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not publish an authoritative coordinate datum for an anchor.

coordinateEvidence.title: Sites along the Uttarapath, Badshahi Sadak, Sadak-e-Azam, Grand Trunk Road
coordinateEvidence.limitations: The listing does not declare a CRS or identify which old/new Rajgriha locus the coordinate denotes.

temporalApplicability.periodLabel: early historic Rajagriha, one Magadhan capital phase

siteEvidence.uncertainty: The site identity is strong, but the coordinate datum and specific locus are not source-closed.
limitations: Not a coordinate of all Magadha.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Archaeological Survey of India Patna Circle: Monuments Details
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Kumrahar and Bulandibagh preserve archaeological remains described in relation to Pataliputra.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: The evidence identifies multiple loci; it does not make one point equivalent to the whole ancient city.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Kumhrar Park, District Patna
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Excavations at Kumhrar uncovered remains of ancient Pataliputra.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not publish an auditable coordinate for the archaeological locus in the held page.

coordinateEvidence.title: Sites along the Uttarapath, Badshahi Sadak, Sadak-e-Azam, Grand Trunk Road
coordinateEvidence.limitations: The held listing does not declare its CRS or select a specific Pataliputra archaeological locus such as Kumrahar or Bulandibagh.

temporalApplicability.periodLabel: later major Magadhan and Mauryan Pataliputra context

siteEvidence.uncertainty: The city has multiple archaeological loci and the source coordinate's CRS/reference meaning remains unresolved.
limitations: Not a coordinate of all Magadha.
No Pataliputra urban extent or centroid.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Taxila World Heritage property
historicalIdentityEvidence.locator: Outstanding Universal Value and serial archaeological-site description
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Taxila is an authenticated serial archaeological property including Bhir, Sirkap and Sirsukh settlement sites.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: The World Heritage property is serial; this record remains a reference point, not the entire complex or Gandhara.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: GANDHARA, Encyclopaedia Iranica
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Places Taxila among the historically central Gandharan cities.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not authorize a coordinate for the full historical region.

coordinateEvidence.title: Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names: Taxila (deserted settlement)
coordinateEvidence.supports: A WGS84 coordinate for a record typed as deserted settlement, archaeological site, ancient site, historic site and World Heritage Site.
coordinateEvidence.limitations: A gazetteer point is a site reference only; it is not an ancient-city footprint or a Gandhara boundary.

temporalApplicability.periodLabel: Taxila settlement sequence, fifth century BCE through second century CE

siteEvidence.uncertainty: The point represents an archaeological-site reference, not the full serial property, historic Taxila urban extent, or Gandhara.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: GANDHARA, Encyclopaedia Iranica
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Identifies Pushkalavati with modern Charsadda in the Gandharan context.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not choose one archaeological locus or coordinate reference point.

historicalIdentityEvidence.title: Investigating ancient Pushkalavati: Excavations at Balar Hisar
historicalIdentityEvidence.locator: project citation as preserved by Getty TGN
historicalIdentityEvidence.supports: Balar Hisar is an archaeological research context for ancient Pushkalavati.
historicalIdentityEvidence.limitations: Does not by itself reconcile all Charsadda-area archaeological loci.

coordinateEvidence.title: Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names: Pushkalavati (ancient site)

siteEvidence.uncertainty: The records are both useful but their reference points differ by 9,606.3 m; this audit does not choose, average or infer an archaeological locus.
limitations: No selection between conflicting reference points.
